name: 0043 stage-4 CLI completion (2-lane claude+codex: implement CLI+web+hull_class+docs, then 2-lane build review)
allow_same_model_review_pairing_rational: Both build reviewers run on claude under DISTINCT postures (ergonomics_dx + threat_model). The codex lane was used for the cross-model threat_model review in the prior run (run_7263118c...): it ran twice, produced a thorough threat review whose findings were all addressed and operator-verified, but it deterministically submits the terminal `reject` verdict on any finding (a known codex-lane verdict-vocab defect — `reject` cannot be cycled or overridden, wedging the run). The cross-model threat signal has therefore already been obtained and discharged; this run gates on a claude threat_model pass (which reliably emits cycleable/overridable verdicts) plus the claude ergonomics_dx pass. Distinct postures produce distinct signals even on the same model.
